name: Financial Instrument Quantity 49 Choice
definition: Choice between formats for the specification of the number of units or amount of money.

UnitsNumber.name: Units Number
UnitsNumber.definition: Number of investment fund units to be subscribed.

GrossAmount.name: Gross Amount
GrossAmount.definition: Amount of money to be paid by the investor when subscribing to fund units. |Gross amount = (Quantity * Price) + (Fees + Taxes).

NetAmount.name: Net Amount
NetAmount.definition: Amount of money to be invested in the fund. |Net Amount = Quantity * Price.

DigitalTokenUnit.name: Digital Token Unit
DigitalTokenUnit.definition: Quantity of digital tokens expressed as a number, for example, a number of blockchain tokens.
